estonia.title: Expert: Elections in Russia are pure submission play and power ritual
estonia.description: The recently concluded Russian State Duma elections will not bring any political change, because their only purpose was to demonstrate the regime's dominance, says Russian politics expert Karmo Tüür.

estonia.title: 3 Latvian suspects in Milrem arson extradited to Estonia, remanded
estonia.description: Three Latvian citizens suspected in an arson attack on an Estonian defense firm have been extradited to Estonia.

estonia.title: Businessman Jaanus Rahumägi: I have no ties to ammunition procurements
estonia.description: Security entrepreneur Jaanus Rahumägi wrote on social media that he is not involved in any ammunition deals. His name has repeatedly come up in media reports and statements by politicians in connection with troubled arms procurements.

estonia.title: Bank of Estonia issues Forest Brothers commemorative coin
estonia.description: The Bank of Estonia will issue a silver commemorative coin Tuesday honoring the Forest Brothers. The silver coin will cost €124 and have a face value of €15.

estonia.title: Estonian police apprehend 46 illegal immigrants in less than a week
estonia.description: Since September 17, police have detained 46 foreign nationals who entered Estonia illegally via Belarus and Latvia. In addition, a court ordered a 54-year-old Romanian citizen held in custody on suspicion of organizing illegal immigration.

estonia.title: 'Border tourism' grows in southeast Estonia as visitors seek out fortifications
estonia.description: Frontier areas in Võru County in southeastern Estonia have seen an uptick in 'border tourism,' including from overseas visitors.

estonia.title: Moomin stories in different languages to feature in European Day of Languages
estonia.description: Vikerraadio is inviting listeners to take part in its annual European Day of Languages game, guessing which languages Moomins stories by Tove Jansson are being read aloud in.

estonia.title: E. coli contamination in Saue private wells unresolved after month-long investigation
estonia.description: E. coli contamination found in private wells in Saue, near Tallinn, in mid-August remains without an identified source after extensive investigation, the local municipality said.

estonia.title: Analyst Rainer Saks to take up post of president's security adviser
estonia.description: Security expert Rainer Saks will join President-elect Ülle Madise's team as national defense and security adviser, ruling out a run for Parempoolsed in next spring's Riigikogu elections.

estonia.title: US think tank paints hypothetical scenario of a limited Russian invasion of Estonia
estonia.description: The U.S.-based Institute for the Study of War (ISW) published an article Monday evening outlining one possible scenario for how Russia could attack Estonia and test NATO's readiness to repel the aggression.

estonia.title: Martin Vaino: A more generous Estonia is bigger and safer
estonia.description: Migration has always been part of human life, and Estonia should embrace both those who leave and those who choose to make the country their home, writes Martin Vaino.

estonia.title: First Estonian to qualify for LA Paralympics eyes career-best form
estonia.description: Estonian paralympian swimmer Matz Topkin is the first athlete from his country to so far qualify for the Los Angeles Paralympics, after winning silver in Turkey.

estonia.title: Neli Eesti orienteerujat võistlevad EMil medalite eest
estonia.description: Neli Eesti koondise meest jõudsid Leedus Druskininkais kolmapäeval alanud orienteerumise Euroopa meistrivõistlustel kvalifikatsioonist edasi tavaraja ja lühiraja A-finaali.

estonia.title: El Niño purustas just kõik rekordid, kuid see on alles algus
estonia.description: Ilmastikunähtus El Niño on saavutanud Vaiksel ookeanil rekordtaseme ning teadlaste hinnangul purustatakse senised rekordid aasta lõpuks veelgi suurema varuga. Nii Suurbritannia ringhääling BBC kui ka riiklik ilmateenistus Met Office kinnitavad, et tegemist on juba praegu mõõtmisajaloo kõige võimsama El Niñoga.

estonia.title: Kõhukinnisust leevendab üllatavalt hästi üks 20-minutiline tegevus
estonia.description: Kõhukinnisus on tüütu mure, mis vaevab paljusid, kuid leevendus võib peituda ootamatult lihtsas igapäevategevuses. Värske uuring paljastab, mis juhtub meie seedekulglas kohe pärast füüsilist pingutust ning miks isegi lühike jalutuskäik seedimise kiirelt käima tõmbab.

estonia.title: Presidendi välisnõunikuks saab Ülle Madise ametiajal Liis Lipre-Järma
estonia.description: Ülle Madise välisnõunikuna asub presidendi kantseleis tööle pikaaegse kogemusega diplomaat Liis Lipre-Järma.

estonia.title: Rahvusvahelise päästeoperatsiooni käigus päästetud loomad aina surevad
estonia.description: Valgevaalade suurt päästeoperatsiooni ajendas Kanada merepargi Marineland sulgemine ja rahalised raskused, mis viisid pargi juhtkonna isegi mõtteni ligi 30 looma eutaneerida. Viimasel hetkel sõlmitud kokkulepete alusel jagati loomad USA ja Hispaania akvaariumide vahel ära.

estonia.title: Euroopa autojuhid maksavad paagitäie diisli eest 30 eurot rohkem. Eestis on hinnatõus suuremgi
estonia.description: Euroopa diislikütuse hind on tänavu tõusnud keskmiselt ligi 40 protsenti ning keskmise 50-liitrise paagi täitmine maksab autojuhile umbes 30 eurot rohkem kui aasta alguses. Eestis on hinnatõus olnud veel suurem – paagitäie eest tuleb praegu välja käia ligikaudu 35 eurot rohkem.

estonia.title: UHKE KLÕPS ⟩ «Kahe nädala toit!» Naissaarelt leitud hiiglasliku sirmiku mõõtmed panevad ahhetama
estonia.description: Naissaare loodus pakkus seenelisele tõelise üllatuse, kui metsast leiti hiiglaslik sirmik, mille kübara läbimõõduks mõõdeti koguni 40 sentimeetrit. Erakordne leid tekitas Facebookis elavat arutelu – võimsat seent võrreldi nii perepitsa, kümneliitrise ämbri kaane kui ka kahe nädala toiduvaruga.

estonia.title: Ralf Tribuntsov võtab olümpia nimel riski, mis pole ujumises kuigi tavaline
estonia.description: Eesti parim meesujuja Ralf Tribuntsov (32) võttis pärast augustis toimunud pika raja EMi riski, hakates õppima uut ujumistehnikat. Kui kõik õnnestub, võiks Tribuntsov olla pooleteise aasta pärast Los Angelese olümpial parem kui kunagi varem.

estonia.title: GALERII ⟩ Foxway tehnoloogiakeskuse uus hoone sai nurgakivi
estonia.description: Täna pandi Tartu külje all Raadil Keskuse teel nurgakivi Foxway uuele hoonele, mis lisab tehnoloogiakeskusele ligi 10 000 ruutmeetrit pinda.

estonia.title: KARL AUGUST HERMANN 175 ⟩ Üks inimene, terve kultuuriline ökosüsteem. Mitmel alal oli ta esimene
estonia.description: 23. septembril möödub 175 aastat Eesti ärkamisaja suurkuju Karl August Hermanni sünnist, mis annab hea võimaluse küsida, kas tema koht Eesti kultuuriloos vastab tema tegelikule panusele. Kui hästi tunneme täna Hermanni tegevuse ulatust ja mõju võrreldes teiste tolle aja ühiskonnategelastega? Kas tema pärand on meie kultuuriloos piisavalt nähtav ja väärtustatud, kirjutavad Pille Lill ja Ilona Kolberg Karl August Hermanni Keskusest.

estonia.title: Vanglas kartserisse paigutatud Vene teatrilavastaja kaalub 42 kilo
estonia.description: Vangistatud Vene teatrilavastaja Jevgenia Berkovitš, kes mõistis hukka Moskva sõja Ukrainas ja kannab ligi kuueaastast karistust, on paigutatud kartserisse ja kaalub vaid 42 kilogrammi, ütles tema advokaat täna AFP-le.

estonia.title: Lajal ja Glinka jõudsid Prantsusmaal veerandfinaali ning võivad kohtuda poolfinaalis
estonia.description: Mark Lajal ja Daniil Glinka jõudsid Prantsusmaal St. Tropez’ Challenger 125 turniiril veerandfinaali ning võivad järgmiste vastaste alistades kohtuda omavahel poolfinaalis.

estonia.title: EL avab Kremli kaubandusterrori alla jäänud Armeenia aprikoosidele ja brändile ukse
estonia.description: Euroopa Liit otsustas vastusammuna Kremli kehtestatud piirangutele anda Armeeniast pärit põllumajandustoodetele järgmiseks kaheks aastaks loa pääseda tollimaksuvabalt ühenduse turule. Tegemist on siiski ajutise mehhanismiga, mis võiks aidata kaasa sellele, et tulevikus ekspordiks Armeenia tooteid ennekõike Euroopa, mitte Venemaa poole.

estonia.title: Ekskavaator tõmbas jõepõhjast välja terve rauaaja majanduse saladuse
estonia.description: Raua olulisust inimkonna ajaloos on raske üle hinnata. Teadlased leidsid hiljuti midagi, mis annab võimaluse selle materjali olulisuse kohta veelgi enam teada saada.

estonia.title: Orienteerumise EM jõuab Eesti vaatajateni otsepildis Postimehe ja Duo Stari vahendusel
estonia.description: 2026. aasta Euroopa meistrivõistlused orienteerumises toimuvad 23.-27. septembrini Leedus Druskininkais.

estonia.title: Eesti Loto avab uue veebikeskkonna
estonia.description: Eesti Loto avab 24. septembril uue veebikeskkonna, mille kasutuselevõtu tõttu on osa teenuseid ajutiselt suletud.

latvia.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
latvia.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

latvia.title: Távozik az Indamedia-csoporttól Ziegler Gábor
latvia.description: Vaszily Miklós ezentúl tulajdonosként és vezérigazgatóként irányítja tovább az Indexszel összefonódva működő cégcsoportot.

latvia.title: Orosz katonai helikopter hatolt be a lengyel légtérbe
latvia.description: A Kalinyigrád felől érkező helikopter 42 másodpercet töltött el a NATO-tagország légterében.

latvia.title: Vaszily egyedül irányítja az Indamedia Csoportot, Ziegler kiszáll
latvia.description: A társtulajdonos a hónap végén távozik.

latvia.title: Távozik Ziegler Gábor, az Indamedia társtulajdonos-vezérigazgatója
latvia.description: Vaszily Miklós az Indexet és a Blikket is birtokoló Indamedia tulajdonosaként és vezérigazgatójaként irányítja tovább a cégcsoportot.

latvia.title: Női játékvezető fizikai bántalmazása és szexista viselkedés miatt rúgták ki az edzőt
latvia.description: Nem gondolkodott el tettein, nem vállalt felelősséget, és nem akart bocsánatot sem kérni.

latvia.title: Akcióba lendültek a NATO vadászgépei, Dobropillja védelme bármikor összeomolhat - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról szerdán
latvia.description: Több diplomáciai csörte is zajlott Ukrajna és Magyarország közt az elmúlt napokban, főleg a Kárpáti Nyolcak nevű társulás és a Naftogaz üzemanyag-tárolója miatt. A két ország vezetői nyilvános platformon szócsatáznak. Közben folytatódnak a harcok Donyeckben: Dobropillja orosz bekerítés szélén áll, ezt a várost használták hídfőállásnak az ukrán erők a pokrovszki harcokban. Tegnap felszólította Donald Trump elnök Putyint arra, hogy fejezze be a háborút. A nap folyamán többször is riasztották a NATO légvédelmi erőit - Lengyelország légterét meg is sértette egy orosz Mi-8-as helikopter. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború fejleményeivel.

latvia.title: Incidens történt: vadászgépeket küldött a NATO egy orosz Mi-8-asra - Megsértette Moszkva a légteret
latvia.description: Egy Mi-8 típusú orosz katonai helikopter szerdán rövid időre berepült a lengyel légtérbe, emiatt felszálltak a lengyel vadászrepülőgépek - közölte a lengyel fegyveres erők műveleti parancsnoksága (DORSZ) az X-en.

latvia.title: Riadót fújt a NATO: két ország vadászgépei is akcióba lendültek - Orosz légtérsértőket kerestek
latvia.description: Potenciális orosz légtérsértés miatt riasztották az éjjel a román és a lengyel légierőt is - írta meg az ABC News .

latvia.title: Támadnak a lázadók: pillanatok alatt elfoglalták a Mekelle repteret
latvia.description: A tigré lázadók elfoglalták az Etiópia északi részén lévő Tigré szövetségi állam repülőterét - közölte szerdán az AFP francia hírügynökség helyi biztonsági forrásokra hivatkozva.

latvia.title: Russia planning “accidental” strikes on eastern NATO states, warns Poland
latvia.description: Russia wants to create a sense of "NATO's helplessness", said Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

latvia.title: Fico zvyšuje riziko vojny, spochybňovanie článku 5 je nebezpečné, varuje expert Havlíček (videopodcast)
latvia.description: „Rusko sa vo svojej imperiálnej agresii nechce a ani nemôže zastaviť iba na Ukrajine, jeho cieľom je vytvoriť si nárazníkovú zónu a posunúť hranice ďalej na Západ. Spochybňovanie kolektívnej obrany NATO zo strany slovenského premiéra je nebezpečné a iba zvyšuje riziko, že sa vojna dotkne aj nás,“ varuje analytik Pavel Havlíček z pražskej Asociácie pre medzinárodné otázky.

latvia.title: „Budeme si rozdávať deky.“ Bihariová a Glück sa pochytili pre článok 5 NATO, vojakov aj šírenie nepravdivých správ
latvia.description: Poslanci Irena Bihariová z Progresívneho Slovenska a Richard Glück zo Smeru debatovali v utorok v relácii Téma dňa na ta3 o výrokoch premiéra Roberta Fica k článku 5 NATO a možnom nasadení slovenských vojakov. Neskôr sa sporili aj o návrh PS na rozšírenie trestného činu šírenia poplašnej správy a o hranice slobody prejavu.

latvia.title: Politikár: Fico se bojí NATO, ne Ruska
latvia.description: Nová epizoda satirického podcastu Politikár se věnuje týdnu, který přinesl Ficovy kontroverzní výroky o článku 5 NATO, prezidentskou zprávu o stavu republiky i další díl kauzy kolem ministra obrany Roberta Kaliňáka. Redaktorka Natália Jabůrková si tentokrát pozvala komiky Martina Hatalu a Matěje Adámyho a témata s nimi s nadhledem probrala.

latvia.title: Grónsko v případě nezávislosti zůstane v NATO, stojí v dohodě s USA
latvia.description: Pokud Grónsko vyhlásí nezávislost na Dánsku, musí zůstat součástí Severoatlantické aliance. USA rovněž získávají právo umístit na ostrově části svého plánovaného systému protiraketové obrany Golden Dome. Uvedla to agentura Reuters, která cituje části dohody o Grónsku, kterou v New Yorku podepsali americký prezident Donald Trump, dánská premiérka Mette Frederiksenová a předseda grónské vlády Jens-Frederik Nielsen. Trump ujednání označil za „milník pro bezpečnost Spojených států, Arktidy a také Evropy“.

latvia.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
latvia.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

latvia.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
latvia.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

latvia.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
latvia.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

latvia.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
latvia.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

latvia.title: Un senator republican cere o anchetă a Congresului SUA cu privire la nunta lui Donald Trump Jr, finanțată de un oligarh rus
latvia.description: Senatorul republican John Curtis a cerut marţi deschiderea unei anchete în Congresul american cu privire la finanțarea de către un om de afaceri rus a unor festivităţi cu ocazia nunţii lui Donald Trump Jr, fiul mai mare al preşedintelui american.

latvia.title: Călin Georgescu și Ionel Rusen au scăpat de arest. Fostul candidat mers la Poliția Buftea pentru controlul judiciar
latvia.description: Călin Georgescu și-a petrecut noaptea în Arestul Central din Capitală, după ce a fost reținut luni, pentru 24 de ore, de procurorii DIICOT. El este cercetat într-un nou dosar în care este acuzat că a înșelat un afacerist cu peste 1.000.000 euro. Tribunalul București a respins, însă, propunerea DIICOT de arestare preventivă și a decis că Ionel Rusen și Călin Georgescu vor fi plasați sub control judiciar. În fața tribunalului s-au strâns zeci de susținători ai acestuia, care au strigat „Nu cedăm!” în momentul în care s-a aflat decizia judecătorilor. Călin Georgescu a părăsit Tribunalul în uralele mulțimii de susținători.

latvia.title: Peiu (AUR): Dacă Grindeanu ne face o invitaţie, ne ducem să vorbim. Majorităţile se fac înainte de consultările de la Cotroceni
latvia.description: Reprezentanţii AUR sunt dispuşi să se întâlnească cu preşedintele PSD, Sorin Grindeanu, dacă acesta lansează o invitaţie la discuţii, a spus marţi liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, care i-a transmis liderului social-democraţilor că „majorităţile se fac înainte de consultările formale de la Cotroceni”.

latvia.title: Cum este descris Putin de doi jurnaliști care au fugit din Rusia: „Războiul din Ucraina este doar un mijloc de a se menține la putere”
latvia.description: La ora 6 dimineața, pe 29 iunie 2021, jurnalistul rus Roman Badanin a fost trezit de o bătaie în ușa apartamentului familiei sale din Moscova. „Vino repede, cineva ți-a zgâriat mașina în curte”, a strigat o voce de afară. În momentul în care a deschis ușa, bărbați mascați au pătruns cu forța înăuntru, relatează The Guardian.

latvia.title: Nicușor Dan, interviu la SiriusXM: Cum vede președintele viitorul NATO, relația cu SUA și sprijinul pentru Ucraina și Moldova
latvia.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan a declarat, într-un interviu acordat emisiunii „The Julie Mason Show” de la postul american de radio SiriusXM, că România are argumentul poziţionării geografice, al bunei cooperări militare şi economice cu SUA, dar şi al pregătirii tehnice şi al potenţialului energetic pentru a-şi dori mai mulţi soldaţi şi investitori americani în ţară. Vorbind despre Ucraina şi Moldova, şeful statului a dat asigurări că incursiunile dronelor în România nu ştirbesc sprijinul acordat Ucrainei, ci dimpotrivă, iar Bucureştiul îşi doreşte ca ambii săi vecini să facă parte din UE şi să aibă armate la standardele NATO.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu reacționează după ce Sorin Grindeanu a vorbit despre un guvern PSD-AUR: „Orice este posibil”. Ce condiții pune
latvia.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor AUR, a declarat marți, în direct la Digi24, că în acest moment nu există negocieri cu social-democrații pentru formarea unui guvern, după ce Sorin Grindeanu a afirmat că nu exclude un Executiv PSD-AUR până la alegerile din 2028. Peiu a precizat însă că o astfel de variantă este posibilă dacă sunt respectate „regulile democratice” și a prezentat trei cerințe la care partidul nu este dispus să renunțe.

latvia.title: Taifunul Dujuan lovește Japonia: ploi puternice, inundații și alunecări de teren. Două milioane de oameni au fost evacuați
latvia.description: Un taifun a adus cantități record de precipitații pe coasta de est a Japoniei și a produs inundații și alunecări de teren. Cel puțin patru oameni au murit, cinci au fost răniți și mai mulți sunt dați dispăruți. Vremea rea amenință și Statele Unite, iar guvernatorul Californiei a declarat stare de urgență înainte ca fenomenul El Nino să lovească statul, arată BBC.

latvia.title: Vânzările de truse de urgență cresc în Lituania din cauza amenințării la adresa securității din partea Rusiei
latvia.description: Vânzările de truse de urgență au crescut brusc în Lituania, au declarat companiile care produc aceste truse cu articole esențiale în caz de criză, din cauza temerilor că războiul Rusiei împotriva Ucrainei se extinde și în țările vecine. Îngrijorările s-au accentuat după ce, lunea trecută, o dronă venind dinspre Belarus a încălcat spațiul aerian lituanian, unde a fost doborâtă de avioane de vânătoare NATO, relatează TVPWorld.

latvia.title: Stare de urgență în California înainte de El Nino. Furtuni violente și valuri uriașe ar putea lovi coasta
latvia.description: Guvernatorul Californiei, Gavin Newsom, a declarat luni stare de urgență înainte de manifestarea fenomenului El Niño pe coasta de vest a SUA, în condițiile în care prognozele indică riscul unor furtuni violente, valuri uriașe și inundații.

latvia.title: Saaremaa residents oppose Elering's planned Estonia–Latvia overhead power line
latvia.description: Many Saaremaa residents — as well as the Saaremaa municipal government — do not support Elering's plan to build a 330 kV Estonia–Latvia overhead power line across Saaremaa. Locals prefer an underground cable or a subsea cable running directly to Latvia.

latvia.title: Illegal immigration to Estonia rises, border rotation extended
latvia.description: Interior Minister Igor Taro (Eesti 200) says illegal immigration into Estonia has grown. Estonia is extending its border‑guard rotation on the Latvia–Belarus border.

latvia.title: Estonian MFA: Rumors of impending Russian attack blown out of proportion
latvia.description: Recent media reports suggesting an imminent Russian attack on NATO and the Baltic states are unfounded, Foreign Ministry Secretary General Jonatan Vseviov said.

latvia.title: 3 Latvian suspects in Milrem arson extradited to Estonia, remanded
latvia.description: Three Latvian citizens suspected in an arson attack on an Estonian defense firm have been extradited to Estonia.

latvia.title: Estonian police apprehend 46 illegal immigrants in less than a week
latvia.description: Since September 17, police have detained 46 foreign nationals who entered Estonia illegally via Belarus and Latvia. In addition, a court ordered a 54-year-old Romanian citizen held in custody on suspicion of organizing illegal immigration.

latvia.title: US think tank paints hypothetical scenario of a limited Russian invasion of Estonia
latvia.description: The U.S.-based Institute for the Study of War (ISW) published an article Monday evening outlining one possible scenario for how Russia could attack Estonia and test NATO's readiness to repel the aggression.

latvia.title: Vanglas kartserisse paigutatud Vene teatrilavastaja kaalub 42 kilo
latvia.description: Vangistatud Vene teatrilavastaja Jevgenia Berkovitš, kes mõistis hukka Moskva sõja Ukrainas ja kannab ligi kuueaastast karistust, on paigutatud kartserisse ja kaalub vaid 42 kilogrammi, ütles tema advokaat täna AFP-le.

latvia.title: OTSE POSTIMEHEST ⟩ Kui valmis on NATO? Stuudios on NATO Euroopa vägede ülemjuhataja asetäitja
latvia.description: Kui valmis on NATO võimalikuks sõjaliseks konfliktiks Venemaaga ja kas Eesti peaks rünnakut kartma? Seekordses saates räägime Kiievis viibiva kolleegi Meinhard Pulgaga olukorrast Ukrainas ning usutleme Tallinnas viibinud NATO Euroopa liitlasvägede ülemjuhataja asetäitjat Sir Johnny Stringerit. Juttu tuleb alliansi kaitseplaanidest, sõjalisest valmisolekust ja Venemaalt lähtuvast ohust. Saade on eetris neljapäeval kell 12.

latvia.title: Attempts to reduce fuel prices being put forward in Latvia
latvia.description: Several draft laws aimed at reducing fuel prices are being put forward for approval by the Saeima. This was decided on Wednesday by the Saeima’s Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee, according to the Saeima Press Service.

latvia.title: Don't dump your apples in the nearest (or farthest) forest
latvia.description: With harvest in full swing, the question of where to put left-over apples, grass and other organic waste becomes more pressing for many home and garden owners.

latvia.title: Infection affects dozens of children in Salaspils kindergarten, Latvia
latvia.description: At the “Jāņtārpiņš” kindergarten in Salaspils, dozens of children have been found to be suffering from an illness of unknown origin. Similar symptoms have also been observed in several adults – members of the nursery staff. The Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (SPKC) has already launched an epidemiological investigation, and the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) will carry out inspections on Wednesday, Latvian Radio reports.

latvia.title: Reminder issued to vaccinate dogs against canine distemper virus
latvia.description: Foxes in Ādaži Municipality have recently been laboratory-confirmed as infected with canine distemper (CDV); therefore, the Food and Veterinary Service (PVD) urges dog owners to ensure that their dog has been vaccinated against this highly contagious viral disease.

latvia.title: Latvians will get European-standard cards for disabled parking
latvia.description: To ensure that people with disabilities have uniform rights to use parking concessions throughout the European Union, the Latvian Ministry of Transport has drawn up amendments to the Road Traffic Regulations, which provide for a gradual transition from the current disabled parking card to the new European parking card.

latvia.title: Hacker detained in Latvia for at least two cyberattacks
latvia.description: On 15 September this year, the State Police arrested a hacker born in 2003 on suspicion of carrying out cyber-attacks against at least two Latvian companies for financial gain, the police said on September 23.

latvia.title: Latvia approves vague plan for curbing immigration
latvia.description: On Tuesday, 22 September, the Government endorsed the plan for measures to restrict immigration drawn up by the Ministry of the Interior (MoI), which includes more than 70 recommendations for controlling and restricting immigration.

latvia.title: Latvian government imposes restrictions on two Russian oligarchs
latvia.description: On Tuesday, the Latvian government imposed nationwide financial and entry restrictions on the Russian oligarchs Mikhail Fridman and Alisher Usmanov, according to documents attached to the agenda of the Cabinet of Ministers’ meeting.

latvia.title: Concerns about traffic flow during repairs of major Rīga bridge
latvia.description: What will the traffic situation be like in Rīga when the dilapidated Vanšu Bridge is repaired? With about a year to go before work begins, this remains unknown. Businesses and the Mārupe Municipal Council are concerned about this, Latvian Radio and Latvian Television reported on September 23.

latvia.title: Road safety week saw more accidents but fewer casualties this year in Latvia
latvia.description: The “Roadpol Safety Days” campaign, organised by the European traffic police network “Roadpol”, has come to an end. During the campaign, police forces across Europe, including in Latvia, focused more actively on road safety than they do on a day-to-day basis, Juris Jančevskis, Head of the Response Directorate at the State Police, said in an interview with Latvian Television on Wednesday morning.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 22nd September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rīga Music Week returns in November
latvia.description: The organisers of Riga Music Week have announced the first 28 artists for the city festival, hailing from eight countries. The festival will take place on 4 and 5 November across seven stages in the Tallinas Street quarter, according to the organisers.

latvia.title: Two out of three jewellery burglars caught in Jelgava, Latvia
latvia.description: Following a chase on Thursday, 17 September, the State Police arrested two people in Jelgava who had burgled a jewellery shop in Bauska a week earlier, the State Police have reported.

latvia.title: Latvian company gets European design award
latvia.description: The Latvian company ‘Carbon Less Future’ has won an award from the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) in the ‘Entrepreneurs and Small Businesses’ category of the ‘DesignEuropa Awards’, LSM.lv reports on September 22.

latvia.title: 'Ulya' a slam dunk amongst Latvian public
latvia.description: Last weekend, Viesturs Kairišs’ feature film Uļa/Ulya became the most-watched film in Latvia on the opening weekend.

latvia.title: Man arrested in Rīga on suspicion of sexual harassment
latvia.description: On 18 September, officers from the Riga Regional Directorate of the State Police detained a man born in 1998 at a shopping centre in Riga, who had allegedly approached underage girls and offered them money in exchange for engaging in sexual acts. The suspect has been remanded in custody.

latvia.title: Ombudsman reports malnutrition at orphanage in Latgale
latvia.description: Ombudsman Karina Palkova has identified significant violations of children’s rights at a children’s home in Latgale, including inadequate nutrition and funding for the children’s needs, as well as staff failing to communicate sufficiently in the state language, Palkova said in an interview on the Latvian Radio programme “Good Morning” on September 22.

latvia.title: Drug bust in Rīga and Ādaži last week
latvia.description: Last week, the police arrested an organised group of six people in Rīga and the surrounding area on suspicion of drug dealing. Several storage facilities were uncovered, and a large quantity of various narcotic substances was seized: cannabis, cocaine, amphetamine and other substances, police said on September 21.

latvia.title: Rīga will seek to slow heating price rise
latvia.description: The Minister for Economic Affairs, Viktors Valainis (Union of Greens and Farmers), has instructed ‘Rīgas siltums’ and the Ministry of Economic Affairs (EM) to draw up proposals this week on how to reduce the expected rise in heating tariffs in Riga. The company currently estimates that the tariff could rise by 20 to 30 per cent from December.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 21st September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Possible air threat warning in Krāslava municipality of Latvia is over
latvia.description: The National Armed Forces have issued a warning covering Krāslava municipality regarding a potential threat to airspace. A cell broadcast alert was sent to residents of this municipality. The warning that had been issued ended shortly before midnight.

latvia.title: Most household energy consumption goes to heating in Latvia
latvia.description: According to the Central Statistical Bureau survey on energy consumption in households, published on September 21, 83.9 % of the energy resources consumed in households in 2025 were used for space and water heating.

latvia.title: National Alliance kicks out violence apologist Dalbiņš
latvia.description: The Executive Committee of the National Alliance (NA) has decided to expel Valts Dalbiņš, a candidate for a seat in the 15th Saeima, from the party, as he has, in posts on social media, justified violence against women and levelled prejudiced accusations against them.

latvia.title: Temporary bridge to be installed during Vanšu Bridge repairs in Rīga
latvia.description: A temporary bridge is to be erected whilst the Vanšu Bridge is being rebuilt, the Mayor of Riga, Viesturs Kleinbergs (Progressives), has stated on September 21.

latvia.title: Less than 1% turnout in Latvia for Russia's so-called elections
latvia.description: According to the State Police, 290 Russian citizens in Rīga took part in the Russian "elections", representing just 0.8 per cent of all Russian citizens eligible to vote in Latvia.

latvia.title: Latvian bank profits down 2.9% in first half of 2026
latvia.description: The Latvian banking sector posted a profit of 205.301 million euros in the first half of this year, which is 2.9 per cent less than in the corresponding period of 2025, according to data published by the Latvian Central Bank (Bank of Latvia) on September 21.

latvia.title: Hint of summer might still come next week in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected frequently in Latvia this week.

latvia.title: More details emerge in big illegal cigarette case in Latvia
latvia.description: Almost two years ago, the police uncovered an illegal cigarette distribution network; some of those involved are now in the dock, whilst others are still awaiting trial. The initial investigation has given rise to several parallel cases, Latvian Television's De Facto reported on September 21.

latvia.title: Buzzing honey yields this year in Latvia
latvia.description: For the fourteenth year running, the Latvian Beekeepers’ Association (LBB) has been organising the ‘Honey Day at the Apiary’ event, with the aim of promoting honey and other bee products to the public. Throughout the month, around 30 apiaries across all regions opened their doors to the public, TV Kurzeme reported on September 20.

latvia.title: 'Catch some flavour' in Kuldīga, Latvia this week
latvia.description: In Kuldīga, the gastronomic event “Catch the Flavour!” is extending into the autumn with beloved seasonal dishes made mainly of spuds. Overall, it has been a busy summer for restaurateurs, and there is still a steady flow of visitors in September, Latvian Radio reported on September 21.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 20th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rain and thunder across Latvia on Monday
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that rain is expected across Latvia on Monday.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Poland international volleyball
latvia.description: A crucial win over Turkiye on September 16th means Latvia has made it into the knock-out stages of the men's European volleyball championships.

latvia.title: LISTEN: Pēteris Vasks sacred music concert
latvia.description: The closing concert of the 29th International Sacred Music Festival featured a special concert of music by this year’s jubilee composer Pēteris Vasks, who is 80 years old.

latvia.title: Latvian border guards stop more illegal crossers
latvia.description: On Thursday, September 17, in Krāslava Municipality, border guards, in cooperation with State Police officers, detained a person transporting individuals who had illegally crossed the state border.

latvia.title: Kulbergs and Braže meet U.S. envoy to Belarus
latvia.description: On Thursday, 17th September 2026, the Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, met with the US Special Envoy to Belarus, John Coale.

latvia.title: KNAB to investigate ZZS handing out booze
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will investigate an incident in which the Union of Greens and Farmers (ZZS) gave bottles of black balsam to senior citizens, KNAB said on September 18. This week, on the Latvian Radio programme “Krustpunktā”, a listener asked ZZS MP Augusts Brigmanis to comment on the fact that, at a seniors’ gathering in Ogre on 23 August, the ZZS had given small souvenirs to senior citizens, including a “small bottle of black balsam” bearing the ZZS’s list number for the forthcoming Saeima elections.

latvia.title: Three for the Weekend: Harvest, Old Town, Mushrooms
latvia.description: You would think the festival season is coming to a close, but that is far from the truth. Here are just a few of what you can attend this weekend.

latvia.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period
latvia.description: In a significant development on September 17th, it was announced that extra NATO jets will be coming to Latvia "to reinforce Latvian airspace protection during elections."

latvia.title: Set of stamps to commemorate Latvian basketball star Uļjana Semjonova
latvia.description: In honour of one of Latvia’s greatest ever sportswomen, the world basketball legend Uļjana Semjonova, the state-owned company “Latvijas Pasts” will issue a block of stamps dedicated to her.

latvia.title: Hockey star and Trump family friend added to Latvia's entry blacklist
latvia.description: The Latvian Minister of Foreign Affairs, Baiba Braže, has decided to include Russian ice hockey superstar Alexander Ovechkin on Latvia's list of personae non gratae, a Foreign Ministry announcement said on September 17th.

latvia.title: Roadworks continue across Latvia
latvia.description: Construction work is continuing on 53 sections of the national road network, according to a release by Latvian State Roads on September 18.

latvia.title: Latvia to buy Czech artillery system instead of original Swedish option
latvia.description: On Tuesday, September 15, the Cabinet of Ministers made a decision to purchase "Morana" 155 mm wheeled artillery systems from the Czech manufacturer Excalibur Army for the needs of the National Armed Forces instead of the Swedish "Archer" systems it originally said it would buy.

latvia.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
latvia.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Friday afternoon will be rainy in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that a new band of precipitation will reach Latvia from the west on Friday afternoon.

latvia.title: Ryanair to expand in Latvia, if government helps
latvia.description: The Irish low-cost airline Ryanair is set to increase its flight schedule in Rīga by around 6 per cent during the coming winter season, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th September, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Fees to be hiked on Russian grain transit, total ban to be considered
latvia.description: The Saeima Budget and Finance (Tax) Committee on Thursday considered amendments to the law in two readings, which provide for increasing fees for grain transit transportation from Russia until the end of the year.

latvia.title: Criminal case launched regarding drunk driving welfare minister in Latvia
latvia.description: The Prosecutor’s Office has received the criminal case against Reinis Uzulnieks, the former Minister for Welfare, who was driving under the influence of alcohol, the LETA news agency reported on September 17.

latvia.title: Streaming platforms will be asked to support Latvian film production
latvia.description: It is planned that in future the major streaming platforms will have to invest money in the development of Latvian cinema every year according to law changes supported by the Saeima on September 17th.

latvia.title: VIDEO. Sīkais rullē ne pa jokam, uzspiežot līdz 187 km/h! Madonas pusē notikusi bīstama pakaļdzīšanās zēnam
latvia.description: Braukt, pārsniedzot ātrumu, nav atļauts. Braukt pie stūres nepilngadīgajam arī nav atļauts. Bet šoreiz Valsts policija ziņo, ka kāds jaunietis pārkāpis abus šos nosacījumus. Un ir arī trešais “grēks”. Piektdien, 18. septembrī, Madonas un Cesvaines apkārtnē norisinājās bīstama “Audi” pakaļdzīšanās, kuras laikā 2013. gadā dzimis zēns, bēgot no policijas, attīstīja ātrumu līdz pat 187 km/h. […]

latvia.title: Lietuvā izstrādāts detalizēts evakuācijas plāns militārā apdraudējuma gadījumam – daži ieteikumi var noderēt arī latviešiem
latvia.description: Latvijā pēdējā laikā daudz dzirdēts par plāna trūkumu. Iedzīvotāji domā savas idejas, taču, kā rīkoties, ja rodas militārs vai kāda cita veida apdraudējums? Kur braukt vai iet? Lietuvā šāds plāns ir tapis. Ir vērts ieskatīties arī mums tajā. Lietuva ir sagatavojusi detalizētu iedzīvotāju evakuācijas plānu militāra apdraudējuma vai nopietnas krīzes gadījumam, un viens no trim […]

latvia.title: Tik viegli, ka kļūs par tavu mīļāko desertu – recepte saldējumam ar datelēm
latvia.description: Kurš teicis, ka saldējumu var ēst tikai vasarā? Šis deserts iederas jebkurā sezonā – ziemā tas būs salds mierinājums, bet pavasarī un rudenī – mazs priekpilns baudījums. Un, ja saldējums ir pašu rokām gatavots no dažām vienkāršām sastāvdaļām, tas garšo vēl īpašāk. Recepte no @edamskaisti. Sastāvdaļas: Bāze: 1. 500 ml saldā krējuma (35%) 2. 2/3 […]

lithuania.title: Erdoğan tells UN that Europe cannot be safe without Turkey
lithuania.description: Speaking at the UN General Assembly, Erdoğan argued that Turkey is an indispensable part of European security architecture. Turkey has been a NATO member since 1952 but its EU accession process has been frozen for nearly a decade.

lithuania.title: New rotation of US troops bound for Lithuania, Lithuanian president says
lithuania.description: It comes despite repeated threats from US President Donald Trump to reduce the US' military presence in Europe.

lithuania.title: Orosz katonai helikopter hatolt be a lengyel légtérbe
lithuania.description: A Kalinyigrád felől érkező helikopter 42 másodpercet töltött el a NATO-tagország légterében.

lithuania.title: Női játékvezető fizikai bántalmazása és szexista viselkedés miatt rúgták ki az edzőt
lithuania.description: Nem gondolkodott el tettein, nem vállalt felelősséget, és nem akart bocsánatot sem kérni.

lithuania.title: Akcióba lendültek a NATO vadászgépei, Dobropillja védelme bármikor összeomolhat - Híreink az orosz-ukrán háborúról szerdán
lithuania.description: Több diplomáciai csörte is zajlott Ukrajna és Magyarország közt az elmúlt napokban, főleg a Kárpáti Nyolcak nevű társulás és a Naftogaz üzemanyag-tárolója miatt. A két ország vezetői nyilvános platformon szócsatáznak. Közben folytatódnak a harcok Donyeckben: Dobropillja orosz bekerítés szélén áll, ezt a várost használták hídfőállásnak az ukrán erők a pokrovszki harcokban. Tegnap felszólította Donald Trump elnök Putyint arra, hogy fejezze be a háborút. A nap folyamán többször is riasztották a NATO légvédelmi erőit - Lengyelország légterét meg is sértette egy orosz Mi-8-as helikopter. Cikkünk folyamatosan frissül az orosz-ukrán háború fejleményeivel.

lithuania.title: Incidens történt: vadászgépeket küldött a NATO egy orosz Mi-8-asra - Megsértette Moszkva a légteret
lithuania.description: Egy Mi-8 típusú orosz katonai helikopter szerdán rövid időre berepült a lengyel légtérbe, emiatt felszálltak a lengyel vadászrepülőgépek - közölte a lengyel fegyveres erők műveleti parancsnoksága (DORSZ) az X-en.

lithuania.title: Riadót fújt a NATO: két ország vadászgépei is akcióba lendültek - Orosz légtérsértőket kerestek
lithuania.description: Potenciális orosz légtérsértés miatt riasztották az éjjel a román és a lengyel légierőt is - írta meg az ABC News .

lithuania.title: Támadnak a lázadók: pillanatok alatt elfoglalták a Mekelle repteret
lithuania.description: A tigré lázadók elfoglalták az Etiópia északi részén lévő Tigré szövetségi állam repülőterét - közölte szerdán az AFP francia hírügynökség helyi biztonsági forrásokra hivatkozva.

lithuania.title: Russia planning “accidental” strikes on eastern NATO states, warns Poland
lithuania.description: Russia wants to create a sense of "NATO's helplessness", said Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

lithuania.title: Fico zvyšuje riziko vojny, spochybňovanie článku 5 je nebezpečné, varuje expert Havlíček (videopodcast)
lithuania.description: „Rusko sa vo svojej imperiálnej agresii nechce a ani nemôže zastaviť iba na Ukrajine, jeho cieľom je vytvoriť si nárazníkovú zónu a posunúť hranice ďalej na Západ. Spochybňovanie kolektívnej obrany NATO zo strany slovenského premiéra je nebezpečné a iba zvyšuje riziko, že sa vojna dotkne aj nás,“ varuje analytik Pavel Havlíček z pražskej Asociácie pre medzinárodné otázky.

lithuania.title: „Budeme si rozdávať deky.“ Bihariová a Glück sa pochytili pre článok 5 NATO, vojakov aj šírenie nepravdivých správ
lithuania.description: Poslanci Irena Bihariová z Progresívneho Slovenska a Richard Glück zo Smeru debatovali v utorok v relácii Téma dňa na ta3 o výrokoch premiéra Roberta Fica k článku 5 NATO a možnom nasadení slovenských vojakov. Neskôr sa sporili aj o návrh PS na rozšírenie trestného činu šírenia poplašnej správy a o hranice slobody prejavu.

lithuania.title: Ruský vojenský vrtuľník nakrátko narušil vzdušný priestor Poľska
lithuania.description: Ruský vojenský vrtuľník Mi-8 v stredu na krátko narušil poľský vzdušný priestor severne od mesta Braniewo pri hraniciach s ruskou Kaliningradskou oblasťou. Do poľského vzdušného priestoru prenikol približne 300 metrov a zostal v ňom 42 sekúnd. Oznámilo to Operačné velenie ozbrojených síl Poľska.

lithuania.title: Politikár: Fico se bojí NATO, ne Ruska
lithuania.description: Nová epizoda satirického podcastu Politikár se věnuje týdnu, který přinesl Ficovy kontroverzní výroky o článku 5 NATO, prezidentskou zprávu o stavu republiky i další díl kauzy kolem ministra obrany Roberta Kaliňáka. Redaktorka Natália Jabůrková si tentokrát pozvala komiky Martina Hatalu a Matěje Adámyho a témata s nimi s nadhledem probrala.

lithuania.title: Grónsko v případě nezávislosti zůstane v NATO, stojí v dohodě s USA
lithuania.description: Pokud Grónsko vyhlásí nezávislost na Dánsku, musí zůstat součástí Severoatlantické aliance. USA rovněž získávají právo umístit na ostrově části svého plánovaného systému protiraketové obrany Golden Dome. Uvedla to agentura Reuters, která cituje části dohody o Grónsku, kterou v New Yorku podepsali americký prezident Donald Trump, dánská premiérka Mette Frederiksenová a předseda grónské vlády Jens-Frederik Nielsen. Trump ujednání označil za „milník pro bezpečnost Spojených států, Arktidy a také Evropy“.

lithuania.title: Un elicopter militar rus Mi-8 a încălcat spațiul aerian al Poloniei, într-o nouă incursiune alarmantă
lithuania.description: Un elicopter militar rus de tip Mi-8 a pătruns miercuri în spaţiul aerian polonez în apropierea frontierei cu exclava rusă Kaliningrad, a declarat armata poloneză, acuzând Moscova că doreşte să pună din nou la încercare apărarea ţării, relatează TVPWorld. Într-un incident separat, calea ferată poloneză a fost din nou vizată. Marți seara, două trenuri de marfă au lovit blocuri de beton aflate pe șinele de cale ferată în estul Poloniei, dar niciunul dintre trenuri nu a deraiat și niciunul dintre mecanici nu a fost rănit.

lithuania.title: „Rusia a pierdut deja războiul din Ucraina”, susține președintele unei țări NATO și UE
lithuania.description: Rusia „a pierdut deja” războiul împotriva Ucrainei, a afirmat președintele lituanian Gitanas Nausėda, invocând costurile militare „enorme” suportate de Moscova.

lithuania.title: Avioane de vânătoare poloneze, ridicate pentru a intercepta un aparat de spionaj rus Il-20, în largul coastei Mării Baltice
lithuania.description: Avioanele de vânătoare poloneze au interceptat marți un avion de spionaj rus în largul coastei poloneze a Mării Baltice, a declarat ministrul Apărării, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz.

lithuania.title: Ce prevede acordul istoric privind Groenlanda: noi baze militare, reguli pentru investiții și promisiuni pentru NATO
lithuania.description: Statele Unite, Danemarca și Groenlanda au semnat, marți, un acord de securitate menit să pună capăt lunilor de tensiuni privind teritoriul danez autonom, după amenințările repetate ale președintelui american Donald Trump de a prelua controlul asupra vastei insule arctice. Reuters a prezentat câteva componente cheie ale acordului, care se adaugă unui pact americano-danez din 1951 privind apărarea Groenlandei, conform unui text publicat de Guvernul danez.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, la CNN: Nu e foarte probabil ca Rusia să atace o țară NATO în următorii unu-doi ani, dar trebuie să fim pregătiți
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan, aflat la New York pentru cea de-a 81-a sesiune a Adunării Generale a Organizaţiei Naţiunilor Unite, a declarat că „nu este foarte probabil” ca Rusia să atace o ţară NATO „în următorii unu-doi ani”, dar România trebuie să fie pregătită. De asemenea, şeful statului nu crede că Rusia este cu adevărat pregătită să pună capăt războiului şi apreciază că preşedintele Donald Trump „are dreptate” că Europa trebuie să se implice mai mult în propria apărare.

lithuania.title: NATO învață în țările baltice cum să poarte un război în epoca dronelor: De ce „un tanc pe câmpul de luptă este acum ca un tort”
lithuania.description: În țările baltice, forțele NATO încearcă zilele acestea să învețe noul mod de a face război, folosindu-se de lecțiile de pe frontul ucrainean, iar militarii văd cum doctrina militară tradițională a devenit învechită și neadecvată.

lithuania.title: Un senator republican cere o anchetă a Congresului SUA cu privire la nunta lui Donald Trump Jr, finanțată de un oligarh rus
lithuania.description: Senatorul republican John Curtis a cerut marţi deschiderea unei anchete în Congresul american cu privire la finanțarea de către un om de afaceri rus a unor festivităţi cu ocazia nunţii lui Donald Trump Jr, fiul mai mare al preşedintelui american.

lithuania.title: Peiu (AUR): Dacă Grindeanu ne face o invitaţie, ne ducem să vorbim. Majorităţile se fac înainte de consultările de la Cotroceni
lithuania.description: Reprezentanţii AUR sunt dispuşi să se întâlnească cu preşedintele PSD, Sorin Grindeanu, dacă acesta lansează o invitaţie la discuţii, a spus marţi liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, care i-a transmis liderului social-democraţilor că „majorităţile se fac înainte de consultările formale de la Cotroceni”.

lithuania.title: Nicușor Dan, interviu la SiriusXM: Cum vede președintele viitorul NATO, relația cu SUA și sprijinul pentru Ucraina și Moldova
lithuania.description: Preşedintele Nicuşor Dan a declarat, într-un interviu acordat emisiunii „The Julie Mason Show” de la postul american de radio SiriusXM, că România are argumentul poziţionării geografice, al bunei cooperări militare şi economice cu SUA, dar şi al pregătirii tehnice şi al potenţialului energetic pentru a-şi dori mai mulţi soldaţi şi investitori americani în ţară. Vorbind despre Ucraina şi Moldova, şeful statului a dat asigurări că incursiunile dronelor în România nu ştirbesc sprijinul acordat Ucrainei, ci dimpotrivă, iar Bucureştiul îşi doreşte ca ambii săi vecini să facă parte din UE şi să aibă armate la standardele NATO.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu reacționează după ce Sorin Grindeanu a vorbit despre un guvern PSD-AUR: „Orice este posibil”. Ce condiții pune
lithuania.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor AUR, a declarat marți, în direct la Digi24, că în acest moment nu există negocieri cu social-democrații pentru formarea unui guvern, după ce Sorin Grindeanu a afirmat că nu exclude un Executiv PSD-AUR până la alegerile din 2028. Peiu a precizat însă că o astfel de variantă este posibilă dacă sunt respectate „regulile democratice” și a prezentat trei cerințe la care partidul nu este dispus să renunțe.

lithuania.title: Taifunul Dujuan lovește Japonia: ploi puternice, inundații și alunecări de teren. Două milioane de oameni au fost evacuați
lithuania.description: Un taifun a adus cantități record de precipitații pe coasta de est a Japoniei și a produs inundații și alunecări de teren. Cel puțin patru oameni au murit, cinci au fost răniți și mai mulți sunt dați dispăruți. Vremea rea amenință și Statele Unite, iar guvernatorul Californiei a declarat stare de urgență înainte ca fenomenul El Nino să lovească statul, arată BBC.

lithuania.title: Vânzările de truse de urgență cresc în Lituania din cauza amenințării la adresa securității din partea Rusiei
lithuania.description: Vânzările de truse de urgență au crescut brusc în Lituania, au declarat companiile care produc aceste truse cu articole esențiale în caz de criză, din cauza temerilor că războiul Rusiei împotriva Ucrainei se extinde și în țările vecine. Îngrijorările s-au accentuat după ce, lunea trecută, o dronă venind dinspre Belarus a încălcat spațiul aerian lituanian, unde a fost doborâtă de avioane de vânătoare NATO, relatează TVPWorld.

lithuania.title: Stare de urgență în California înainte de El Nino. Furtuni violente și valuri uriașe ar putea lovi coasta
lithuania.description: Guvernatorul Californiei, Gavin Newsom, a declarat luni stare de urgență înainte de manifestarea fenomenului El Niño pe coasta de vest a SUA, în condițiile în care prognozele indică riscul unor furtuni violente, valuri uriașe și inundații.

lithuania.title: Estonian MFA: Rumors of impending Russian attack blown out of proportion
lithuania.description: Recent media reports suggesting an imminent Russian attack on NATO and the Baltic states are unfounded, Foreign Ministry Secretary General Jonatan Vseviov said.

lithuania.title: US think tank paints hypothetical scenario of a limited Russian invasion of Estonia
lithuania.description: The U.S.-based Institute for the Study of War (ISW) published an article Monday evening outlining one possible scenario for how Russia could attack Estonia and test NATO's readiness to repel the aggression.

lithuania.title: Vanglas kartserisse paigutatud Vene teatrilavastaja kaalub 42 kilo
lithuania.description: Vangistatud Vene teatrilavastaja Jevgenia Berkovitš, kes mõistis hukka Moskva sõja Ukrainas ja kannab ligi kuueaastast karistust, on paigutatud kartserisse ja kaalub vaid 42 kilogrammi, ütles tema advokaat täna AFP-le.

lithuania.title: OTSE POSTIMEHEST ⟩ Kui valmis on NATO? Stuudios on NATO Euroopa vägede ülemjuhataja asetäitja
lithuania.description: Kui valmis on NATO võimalikuks sõjaliseks konfliktiks Venemaaga ja kas Eesti peaks rünnakut kartma? Seekordses saates räägime Kiievis viibiva kolleegi Meinhard Pulgaga olukorrast Ukrainas ning usutleme Tallinnas viibinud NATO Euroopa liitlasvägede ülemjuhataja asetäitjat Sir Johnny Stringerit. Juttu tuleb alliansi kaitseplaanidest, sõjalisest valmisolekust ja Venemaalt lähtuvast ohust. Saade on eetris neljapäeval kell 12.

lithuania.title: Extra NATO jets coming to Latvia during election period
lithuania.description: In a significant development on September 17th, it was announced that extra NATO jets will be coming to Latvia "to reinforce Latvian airspace protection during elections."

lithuania.title: Group of asylum seekers returned to Latvia from Poland
lithuania.description: This week in Poland, several dozen migrants who had applied for asylum in Latvia were stopped in a lorry. The group was heading towards Germany, but they were returned to Latvia via Lithuania, Latvian Television reported on September 17.

lithuania.title: Lietuvā izstrādāts detalizēts evakuācijas plāns militārā apdraudējuma gadījumam – daži ieteikumi var noderēt arī latviešiem
lithuania.description: Latvijā pēdējā laikā daudz dzirdēts par plāna trūkumu. Iedzīvotāji domā savas idejas, taču, kā rīkoties, ja rodas militārs vai kāda cita veida apdraudējums? Kur braukt vai iet? Lietuvā šāds plāns ir tapis. Ir vērts ieskatīties arī mums tajā. lithuania.title: Krievijas militārais helikopters ielidojis Polijā – valsts paceļ iznīcinātājus
lithuania.description: Krievijas militārais helikopters Mi-8 trešdien, 23. septembrī, īslaicīgi pārkāpis NATO dalībvalsts Polijas gaisa telpu. Incidents noticis pie robežas ar Krievijas Karaļauču apgabalu, un Polijas bruņotie spēki reaģējuši, paceļot gaisā iznīcinātājus. Polijas militārā vadība notikušo raksturo kā kārtējo Krievijas mēģinājumu pārbaudīt valsts pretgaisa aizsardzības gatavību. lithuania.title: Zelenskis: Krievija šogad sagrābusi 890 kvadrātkilometrus, Ukraina atbrīvojusi 800
lithuania.description: Krievija šogad sagrābusi aptuveni 890 kvadrātkilometrus Ukrainas teritorijas, bet Ukraina atbrīvojusi 800 kvadrātkilometrus, intervijā laikrakstam “Wall Street Journal” sacīja Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis. “Šogad viņš [Krievijas diktators Vladimirs Putins] sagrāba aptuveni 890 kvadrātkilometrus, bet mēs atbrīvojām 800. lithuania.description: ASV prezidents Donalds Tramps un Ukrainas prezidents Volodimirs Zelenskis Ņujorkā tikušies klātienē aptuveni uz 40 minūšu garu sarunu, bet pēc sarunas par tās norisi atklātas jaunas detaļas. lithuania.title: Atkal izplatās ziņas par Zelenska un viņa sievas “jaunajām Izraēlas pasēm”: atklāta arī patiesība
lithuania.description: Sociālajos tīklos atkal izplatīts attēls, kurā it kā redzamas Ukrainas prezidenta Volodimira Zelenska un viņa sievas Olenas Zelenskas Izraēlas pases. Ierakstu autori apgalvo, ka Zelenskis un viņa ģimene par savu “dzimteni” esot izvēlējušies Izraēlu, taču šis apgalvojums nav patiess, to noskaidrojis “Euronews” faktu pārbaudes projekts The Cube. lithuania.title: Marco Rubio: JAV kviečia Vladimirą Putiną dalyvauti G20 aukščiausiojo lygio susitikime
lithuania.description: Jungtinės Valstijos pakvietė Rusijos prezidentą Vladimirą Putiną dalyvauti gruodį Majamyje vyksiančiame Didžiojo dvidešimtuko (G20) aukščiausiojo lygio susitikime, trečiadienį pranešė JAV valstybės sekretorius Marco Rubio (Markas Rubijas).

lithuania.title: Marco Rubio: JAV nori, kad Ukraina ir Rusija nutrauktų smūgius energetikos infrastruktūrai
lithuania.description: JAV valstybės sekretorius Marco Rubio (Markas Rubijas) trečiadienį pareiškė, jog Vašingtonas siekia, kad Rusija ir Ukraina nutrauktų smūgius viena kitos energetikos infrastruktūrai.

lithuania.title: Ar AfD lyderė Alice Weidel tikrai atskleidė Volodymyro Zelenskio paslaptis?
lithuania.description: Socialiniuose tinkluose nuskambėjo istorija apie Vokietijos radikalių dešiniųjų partijos „Alternatyva Vokietijai“ (AfD) lyderės Alice Weidel kaltinimus Ukrainos vadovui Volodymyrui Zelenskiui. Vokiečių politikė esą atskleidė prezidento nusikaltimus. Nors įvykį internautai pakrikštijo „šimtmečio skandalu“, jis yra visiškai išgalvotas.

lithuania.title: Suomijoje nugriaudėjo sprogimai: kodėl puolė sprogdinti slėptuves?
lithuania.description: Suomija pirmą kartą per daugiau nei 30 metų atliko civilinės saugos slėptuvių atsparumo sprogimams bandymus. Šiais pratybomis siekta įvertinti, ar esama infrastruktūra gali atlaikyti šiuolaikinio karo keliamas grėsmes.

lithuania.title: „Išsaugokite beržą“: Kretingoje susirūpinta ant griaunamo bokšto augančiu medžiu
lithuania.description: Kretingoje griaunamas nuo sovietmečio stovėjęs vandens bokštas. Aplink bokštą jau sumontuoti pastoliai, tačiau žmonės susirūpino beržo, netikėtai išaugusio ant 45 metrų bokšto, likimu. Atsirado netgi peticija su iniciatyva išsaugoti beržą.
